requirement.description: The Tags class constructor does not properly validate inputs. It accepts any dict or AWSHelperFn without checking if they're valid for the specific context where Tags are used (e.g., JobDefinition, Table resources). This leads to runtime errors instead of proper TypeError exceptions being raised at construction time.
requirement.contract: The Tags class should validate that when used in contexts like JobDefinition or Table resources, only valid types (Tags instances, plain dicts, or AWSHelperFn) are accepted. When invalid types are passed (like plain strings or other non-dict objects), a TypeError should be raised immediately during construction.
